title: Wood economy: denser trees, sunflower seeds, wooden power & mills, cistern, fence
detail: ~2.6x starting trees; Sunflower Field (seeds); wooden Windmill + Water Mill (clean power); Processing Mill (seeds+power -> fertilizer -> farm yield); Water Cistern (storage + rain collection); Wooden Fence; friendly squirrels speed timber construction. Next (big): beaver wood-store + sabotage, squirrels as faster gatherer/builder units, wooden lifts/pulley mines/conveyances.

timeline.note: Shipped data-first in PR #43; 7 new smoke checks (68 total).
